title.zh: 柳柏露 · 火电紊乱与燃点管理
title.en: Yanagi / Burnice / Lucy · Disorder and Heat management

summary.zh: 露西备加油，柏妮思建立灼伤并保留燃点，柳前台积蓄并对真实异常结算。
summary.en: Lucy supplies Cheer On, Burnice establishes Scorched and preserves Heat, and Yanagi builds on field and resolves actual Anomalies.

conditions.zh: 按露西→柏妮思→柳循环站位；柳主攻，0影无专武即可执行。
conditions.en: Use Lucy→Burnice→Yanagi cyclic order, with Yanagi as focus; M0 without signatures can execute the reference.

conditions.zh: 柏妮思按未觉醒机制；不引入流火入场或潜能专属触发。
conditions.en: Burnice uses unawakened mechanics; no Firestream entry or Potential-only triggers are included.

conditions.zh: 原作者为1.2／1.3，当前按固定3.3技能核对；灼伤不等于灼烧，不能假定每次柳EX都极性。
conditions.en: The authors wrote in 1.2/1.3, checked against fixed 3.3 skills. Scorched is not Burn; Yanagi EX does not always trigger Polarity.

label.zh: 小橙子 · 柳操作与火电队（1.3）
label.en: Orange · Yanagi mechanics and Fire/Electric team (1.3)

label.zh: 小橙子 · 柏妮思燃点与后台机制（1.2）
label.en: Orange · Burnice Heat and off-field mechanics (1.2)

objective.zh: 先备加油与灼伤，再让柳接战。
objective.en: Prepare Cheer On and Scorched before Yanagi takes field time.

title.en: Lucy establishes Cheer On for both damage dealers

input.zh: 能量足够时点按或长按EX；命中后按柏妮思快支提示。
input.en: With enough energy, tap or hold EX; take Burnice’s Quick Assist prompt after a hit.

trigger.zh: 加油需要建立或刷新；柏妮思处于露西下一位。
trigger.en: Cheer On needs establishing or refreshing; Burnice is Lucy’s next slot.

complete.zh: 小猪实际爆炸后才确认加油；敌人实际命中才出现快支。
complete.en: Count Cheer On after the boar explosion; a Quick Assist requires an actual enemy hit.

reason.zh: 作者火电队允许露西替换凯撒，使柳和后台柏妮思都获得加攻。
reason.en: The author’s Fire/Electric team allows Lucy to replace Caesar, benefiting both Yanagi and off-field Burnice.

fallback.zh: 缺能量先用当前角色补资源；普通特殊技召猪不等于加油。
fallback.en: Without energy, build resources with the available agent; summoning boars with normal Special is not Cheer On.

signal.zh: 实际出现下一位柏妮思快支提示时再接。
signal.en: Take the actual next-slot Burnice Quick Assist prompt.

title.zh: 柏妮思快支入场，再检查燃点

input.en: Respond to Burnice’s Quick Assist prompt.

trigger.zh: 露西EX实际命中产生了柏妮思提示。
trigger.en: Lucy’s EX actually hit and generated Burnice’s prompt.

complete.zh: 确认入场与当前燃点；快支本身不当作自动挂上灼伤。
complete.en: Confirm entry and current Heat; the Quick Assist itself is not assumed to apply Scorched.

reason.zh: 燃油特调与灼伤需要对应技能及真实状态，不能由普通入场替代。
reason.en: Nitro-Fuel Cocktail and Scorched require their proper moves and actual states, not mere entry.

fallback.zh: 无提示跳过；普通换入后按实际燃点选择长普或EX补燃点。
fallback.en: Skip without a prompt. After a normal switch, choose the held Basic or EX based on real Heat.

title.zh: 燃油特调下长普挂灼伤
title.en: Held Basic applies Scorched during Nitro-Fuel Cocktail

input.zh: 处于燃油特调时长按普攻，完成终结一击。
input.en: Hold Basic in Nitro-Fuel Cocktail and complete the finishing hit.

trigger.zh: 实际处于燃油特调且燃点够用；按未觉醒技能消耗20燃点。
trigger.en: Actually in Nitro-Fuel Cocktail with usable Heat; this unawakened move spends 20 Heat.

complete.zh: 确认技能命中挂上灼伤；是否已打出灼烧另看异常槽。
complete.en: Confirm the hit applies Scorched; check the Anomaly gauge separately for actual Burn.

reason.zh: 灼伤是余烬标记，灼烧才是异常状态；柳不能仅凭灼伤就必然触发极性紊乱。
reason.en: Scorched is the Afterburn mark; Burn is the Anomaly. Scorched alone does not guarantee Yanagi’s Polarity Disorder.

fallback.zh: 燃油特调已结束就先用合法EX补燃点至重新开启；不要按不存在的长普状态执行。
fallback.en: If Nitro-Fuel Cocktail ended, use available EX to restore Heat and reactivate it before using this held Basic.

title.zh: 合法衔接双喷，补火异常与燃点
title.en: Link Double Shot to build Fire Anomaly and Heat

input.zh: 长普终结一击后，或单喷期间，能量足够再按EX衔接双喷。
input.en: After the held Basic finisher or during Single Shot, press EX with enough energy to link Double Shot.

trigger.zh: 前置衔接真实成立、能量足够；需要补燃点或火积蓄。资源已足时可省略双喷，但柏仍在前台就先普通切柳再继续。
trigger.en: The preceding link is valid and energy is sufficient. If Heat and Fire setup are already sufficient, skip Double Shot but still switch normally to Yanagi if Burnice is on field.

complete.zh: 按实际消耗查看燃点，确认需要的火异常；结束冲击完成后普通切柳。
complete.en: Read Heat from actual energy spent and verify the needed Fire Anomaly; after the finishing blast, switch normally to Yanagi.

reason.zh: 长喷不是无限能量；保留余烬资源后让柳站场触发，而非无条件一直双喷。
reason.en: Extended spraying does not grant infinite energy; retain Afterburn resources and give Yanagi field time.

fallback.zh: 无法衔接时先用合法单喷；目标只有灼伤未异常时，柳先补积蓄而不是宣布已极性。
fallback.en: If the link is unavailable, use a valid Single Shot first. If only Scorched is present, Yanagi must establish an Anomaly before claiming Polarity.

signal.zh: 双喷关键冲击完成后普通切柳；这一步没有快支。
signal.en: After Double Shot’s key blast, switch normally to Yanagi; this is not Quick Assist.

title.zh: 异常目标上长按EX，确认极性紊乱
title.en: Hold EX against an Anomalous target

input.zh: 能量足够时长按强化特殊技，完成下落攻击。
input.en: With enough energy, hold EX Special and complete the downward attack.

trigger.zh: 下落攻击命中时目标确实处于属性异常；不是只看上一步曾经挂过。
trigger.en: The target must still be under an Attribute Anomaly when the downward attack hits.

complete.zh: 确认下落命中异常目标后触发极性紊乱；火电普通紊乱必须另有真实异常施加。
complete.en: Confirm the downward hit triggers Polarity on an Anomalous target; ordinary Fire/Electric Disorder needs an actual separate Anomaly application.

reason.zh: 柳负责前台电积蓄；余烬在燃点、灼伤和队友命中条件都满足时继续积蓄火异常。
reason.en: Yanagi builds Electric on field; Afterburn builds Fire only with Heat, Scorched and actual allied hits.

fallback.zh: 无异常先打积蓄；缺能量先用合法普攻和流转，不空按EX。
fallback.en: Without an Anomaly, build one first. Without energy, use valid Basics and stance switches.

label.zh: 余烬 · 燃点足够、灼伤有效且其他角色实际命中
label.en: Afterburn · sufficient Heat, Scorched target and actual allied hits

prep.zh: 开场燃点赠送不重复到每轮；重新开燃油特调看50门槛。
prep.en: Opening Heat is not granted every loop; reactivating Cocktail requires reaching its 50 threshold.

objective.zh: 只在需要时补燃点，其他时间由柳积蓄。
objective.en: Restore Heat when needed and otherwise let Yanagi build.

title.zh: 燃点不足时以EX重新准备
title.en: Use EX when Heat needs restoring

input.zh: 能量足够时发动单喷，按需保持并控制能量。
input.en: With enough energy, start Single Shot and extend it only as needed.

trigger.zh: 燃油特调已结束或余烬库存不足；能量实际足够。
trigger.en: Nitro-Fuel Cocktail ended or Afterburn resources are low, with actual energy available.

complete.zh: 燃点达到50才重新进入燃油特调；确认后命中才建立灼伤。
complete.en: Re-enter Nitro-Fuel Cocktail only on reaching 50 Heat; confirm a qualifying hit then applies Scorched.

reason.zh: 持续中的燃油特调不会跌破50就立刻结束，须区分重新开启门槛与耗尽退出。
reason.en: An already-active Cocktail does not end merely by falling below 50; distinguish the activation threshold from ending at depletion.

fallback.zh: 能量不足先回柳的合法站场积蓄；没有燃点时移除余烬预期。
fallback.en: Without energy, return to Yanagi’s available buildup; do not expect Afterburn with no Heat.

title.zh: 合法衔接双喷，补火异常与燃点
title.en: Link Double Shot to build Fire Anomaly and Heat

input.zh: 长普终结一击后，或单喷期间，能量足够再按EX衔接双喷。
input.en: After the held Basic finisher or during Single Shot, press EX with enough energy to link Double Shot.

label.en: Afterburn · sufficient Heat, Scorched target and actual allied hits

title.zh: 柳普攻与流转维持站场循环
title.en: Yanagi sustains the Basic and stance loop

input.zh: 普攻第3、4或5段后点按特殊技，再接第三段普攻。
input.en: Tap Special after Basic 3, 4 or 5, then resume from Basic 3.

trigger.zh: 需要补电异常、能量或刷新架势；加油和柏妮思状态有效。
trigger.en: Build Electric Anomaly or energy, or refresh stances while Cheer On and Burnice’s states remain active.

complete.zh: 确认电异常与双架势效果；燃点耗尽回柏补，露西加油到期回开局刷新。
complete.en: Check Electric Anomaly and both stance buffs; return to Burnice if Heat depletes, or refresh Lucy via opening setup when Cheer On expires.

reason.zh: 切换架势可以保留前一架势效果；不以固定普攻次数保证感电或资源满。
reason.en: Stance switching retains the previous stance’s effect; fixed Basic counts do not guarantee Shock or full resources.

fallback.zh: 被打断时按当前可用普攻接起；不要为保持固定次数而漏掉真实闪避。
fallback.en: After interruption, resume from available Basics; do not ignore real dodge opportunities to preserve a fixed count.

label.zh: 余烬 · 燃点足够、灼伤有效且其他角色实际命中
label.en: Afterburn · sufficient Heat, Scorched target and actual allied hits

prep.zh: 露西加油失效先回开局刷新；柏妮思无需补资源时可跳过喷射。
prep.en: Refresh Lucy through opening setup when Cheer On expires; skip Burnice’s sprays if resources are already sufficient.

objective.zh: 以柏Q真实快支续喷接柳，再兑现可用极性结算。
objective.en: Use Burnice’s real Ultimate assist extension to hand to Yanagi, then resolve available Polarity hits.

title.zh: 柏妮思Q跃起后快支交柳
title.en: Burnice’s Ultimate hands to Yanagi after the leap

input.zh: 柏妮思终结技就绪时释放，跃起出现提示后响应。
input.en: Use Burnice’s ready Ultimate; respond to the prompt after she leaps.

trigger.zh: 自己的终结技就绪、目标可命中，柳处于下一位。
trigger.en: Her own Ultimate is ready, the target can be hit, and Yanagi is the next slot.

complete.zh: 发动回复50燃点；跃起真实快支提示出现即可交棒，不必等喷射结束。
complete.en: Activation restores 50 Heat. Hand over on the actual airborne Quick Assist prompt without waiting for the spray to end.

reason.zh: 技能明确规定响应快支延长喷射，可让柳接战与真实续喷重叠。
reason.en: The skill explicitly extends the spray when Quick Assist is accepted, allowing Yanagi’s entry to overlap it.

fallback.zh: 未就绪回EX补燃点；没有提示时完成动作再普通切柳，不冒充延长。
fallback.en: If unavailable, restore Heat with EX. Without a prompt, finish then switch normally; do not assume the extension.

signal.zh: 跃起后出现柳的实际快支提示就接柳。
signal.en: Take Yanagi’s actual Quick Assist prompt after the leap.

title.en: Yanagi takes the actual Quick Assist

input.zh: 按柳的快速支援提示，接战后可衔接第三段普攻。
input.en: Respond to Yanagi’s Quick Assist; Basic can then begin from its third hit.

trigger.zh: 柏妮思Q跃起产生的柳快支提示真实存在。
trigger.en: Burnice’s airborne Ultimate has actually generated Yanagi’s Quick Assist prompt.

complete.zh: 确认快支入场并命中；柏妮思续喷只保留到其动作实际结束。
complete.en: Confirm assist entry and the hit; Burnice’s continued spray lasts only until its actual animation ends.

reason.zh: 这次支援会延长柏妮思Q喷射；后台续招与持续余烬是两项不同机制。
reason.en: This assist extends Burnice’s Ultimate spray; that continuation and ongoing Afterburn are different mechanics.

fallback.zh: 没有快支提示则跳过；通过普通换人入场后按实际资源继续。
fallback.en: Skip without a Quick Assist prompt; after a normal switch continue with the real resources.

label.zh: Q续喷 · 已响应快支且喷射动作仍在
label.en: Extended Ultimate spray · assist accepted and the spray still ongoing

label.en: Afterburn · sufficient Heat, Scorched target and actual allied hits

title.zh: 柳Q就绪，对异常目标落雷
title.en: Use Yanagi’s ready Ultimate against an Anomalous target

trigger.zh: 自己的终结技就绪；落雷命中时目标确实仍处于属性异常。
trigger.en: Her own Ultimate is ready and the target remains under an Attribute Anomaly when lightning hits.

complete.zh: 落雷实际命中才确认极性紊乱；随后可接第三段普攻。
complete.en: Confirm Polarity only after the lightning actually hits; Basic can then resume from its third hit.

reason.zh: 当前每人有独立喧响，旧攻略“终结技只留给柳”不适用本流程。
reason.en: Agents now have independent Decibels; old advice to reserve a shared Ultimate only for Yanagi is not used.

fallback.zh: 无异常先补；Q未就绪继续当前可用普攻与流转。
fallback.en: Build an Anomaly if absent; if Ultimate is unavailable, continue valid Basics and stance switches.

label.zh: 余烬 · 燃点足够、灼伤有效且其他角色实际命中
label.en: Afterburn · sufficient Heat, Scorched target and actual allied hits

label.en: Afterburn · sufficient Heat, Scorched target and actual allied hits

prep.zh: 先确认加油、燃点与目标异常；两人的Q分别按各自就绪判断。
prep.en: Confirm Cheer On, Heat and the target’s Anomaly; check each agent’s Ultimate independently.

text.zh: 柏1影提高燃点上限并增加开场燃点；不代表灼伤永不消失，仍检查消耗。
text.en: Burnice M1 raises Heat capacity and starting Heat; Scorched still ends when the state depletes.

text.zh: 柏6影双喷追加特殊余烬；终结冲击对灼烧目标的额外结算有同目标间隔，不在每次命中重复发放。
text.en: Burnice M6 adds special Afterburn to Double Shot; its finishing-blast Burn resolution has a per-target cooldown, not a grant on every hit.

text.zh: 柳2影重复突刺要额外能量，极性仍在下落攻击结算；不要每次突刺各算一份。
text.en: Yanagi M2 repeated thrusts cost extra energy; Polarity resolves on the downward attack, not once per thrust.

text.zh: 露西6影可由队友EX命中续加油，受次数和时长上限约束；柏妮思双喷不会无限续。
text.en: Lucy M6 extends Cheer On through allied EX hits within count and duration caps; Burnice’s Double Shot cannot extend it forever.

text.zh: 柏专武的后台回能有利于换柳；增伤及精通仍需真实命中叠层，不预填满层。
text.en: Burnice’s signature benefits from off-field energy regeneration; DMG and Proficiency still need actual hit-based stacks.

text.zh: 柳专武的精通需特殊技命中异常目标；紊乱增益另看自身精通门槛。
text.en: Yanagi’s signature Proficiency requires a Special hit on an Anomalous target; its Disorder benefit also checks the Proficiency threshold.

ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.柳按真实快支入场: 看到柳的快支提示再入场
ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.异常目标上长按EX，确认极性紊乱: 目标已有异常时长按强化特殊技
ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.露西EX先给双输出加油: 强化特殊技命中后看柏妮思的提示
ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.柏妮思快支入场，再检查燃点: 看到柏妮思的快支提示再入场
ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.燃油特调下长普挂灼伤: 燃油特调中长按普攻挂灼伤
ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.合法衔接双喷，补火异常与燃点: 长按普攻收尾或单喷后，按强化特殊技接双喷
ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.燃点不足时以EX重新准备: 缺燃点时用强化特殊技单喷
ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.柳普攻与流转维持站场循环: 普攻后三段接特殊技，再接普攻
ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.柏妮思Q跃起后快支交柳: 开终结技，跃起后看柳的快支提示
ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.柳Q就绪，对异常目标落雷: 柳的终结技就绪时使用

ROTATION_LESSON_INPUTS.能量足够时点按或长按EX；命中后按柏妮思快支提示。: 能量足够时点按或长按强化特殊技；命中并出现柏妮思的快速支援提示后，再按支援键。
ROTATION_LESSON_INPUTS.按柏妮思快支提示。: 屏幕出现柏妮思的快速支援提示时，按对应支援键。
ROTATION_LESSON_INPUTS.长普终结一击后，或单喷期间，能量足够再按EX衔接双喷。: 长按普攻打完最后一击后，或已在单喷时，能量够再按强化特殊技接双喷。
ROTATION_LESSON_INPUTS.能量足够时发动单喷，按需保持并控制能量。: 有能量时按强化特殊技开始单喷；需要延长就继续按住，同时留意剩余能量。
ROTATION_LESSON_INPUTS.柏妮思终结技就绪时释放，跃起出现提示后响应。: 柏妮思的终结技就绪时按终结技。看到她跃起并出现柳的快速支援提示后，再按支援键。
ROTATION_LESSON_INPUTS.终结技：雷影天华。: 柳自己的终结技就绪时，按终结技，让落雷命中。

ROTATION_RECOVERY_INPUTS.1171: 燃点不够且有能量时按强化特殊技单喷；已处于燃油特调则可长按普攻。
ROTATION_RECOVERY_INPUTS.1221: 点普攻打到第3、4或5段，再点特殊技切换架势；目标已有异常且能量够，才能长按强化特殊技打极性紊乱。

ROTATION_ADAPTED_INPUTS.115100005: 能量足够时按强化特殊技，等小猪爆炸并命中
ROTATION_ADAPTED_INPUTS.117100014: 终结技就绪时点按终结技，完成本次喷射

117100002: 燃油特调期间长按普攻；若用此动作接双喷，等长按普攻的终结一击发动，再按强化特殊技。
Hold Basic in Nitro-Fuel Cocktail. To link this move into the double shot, wait for its finishing hit to begin, then press EX.
117100007: 双喷前的普攻不是必打：可接在燃油特调长按普攻的终结一击之后，或在单喷中直接按强化特殊技；两条路都要有能量。
Basic is optional before the double shot: link EX after the held Basic finisher in Nitro-Fuel Cocktail, or directly during the single shot, with sufficient Energy.
122100002: 切架势的这条普通特殊技路线：在普攻第三、四或五段后点特殊技；切完再点普攻直达新架势第三段。不是强化特殊技的必备前置。
For this normal Special stance change, tap Special after Basic hit 3, 4 or 5. Tap Basic after the switch to start at hit 3 in the new stance; this is not required before EX.
122100008: 本步终结技前不用普攻；落雷后想续段，可点普攻接第三段。
No Basic before the Ultimate. After the lightning strike, optionally link into Basic hit 3.
122100010: 先响应快速支援；要续普攻可在入场后直接接第三段，不必先普攻。
Respond to Quick Assist first; optionally link into Basic hit 3 on entry without an earlier Basic string.

1171: 已在燃油特调时才可改用长按普攻；普攻不是强化特殊技单喷的前置。
The held Basic is a recovery option in Nitro-Fuel Cocktail, not a prerequisite for the EX single shot.
1221: 要按普通特殊技切架势，才在普攻第三、四或五段衔接。要打极性紊乱则是目标已有异常、有能量时长按强化特殊技，不用先打普攻。
Use Basic hit 3, 4 or 5 for the normal Special stance link. For Polarity Disorder, hold EX with Energy on an afflicted target; no Basic opener.
